item.title: Commissioners Approve Letter Supporting NEPA Categorical Exclusions for Reactor Projects
item.description: SWEETWATER COUNTY — The Sweetwater County Board of County Commissioners approved a letter of support for regulatory changes proposed by the U.S. Department of Energy.
